pw_slow_hash.note: Werkzeug's scrypt adds a random salt to each hash. Login checks with check_password_hash (app.py:166).

token_csprng.note: The token comes from Python's cryptographic RNG (32 bytes). Only its SHA-256 hash is stored (app.py:172).

no_hardcoded_secret.note: No literal key or secret appears. The app has no signing key at all: it uses random tokens stored server-side. The dummy hash is built from random input at startup.

token_expiry.evidence: app.py:172 int(time.time())+86400 ; app.py:121 'SELECT user_id FROM sessions WHERE token_hash=? AND expires>?'
token_expiry.note: Sessions expire after 24 hours, and the auth check enforces this.

logout_revokes.evidence: app.py:179 db().execute('DELETE FROM sessions WHERE token_hash=?', (g.token_hash,))
logout_revokes.note: POST /api/logout deletes the session row on the server. The client calls it at static/app.js:89.

owner_checks.evidence: app.py:137 'SELECT * FROM notes WHERE id=? AND user_id=?'; app.py:208 row = owned(note_id); app.py:215 'DELETE FROM notes WHERE id=? AND user_id=?'; app.py:221 'UPDATE notes SET ... WHERE id=? AND user_id=?'; app.py:227 if owned(note_id) is None
owner_checks.note: Reading, updating, deleting and sharing all go through owned() and return 404 for notes the user doesn't own. The write queries also filter on user_id.

share_token_strong.evidence: app.py:229 token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32) if request.method == 'POST' else None
share_token_strong.note: The share token is 256 bits from the cryptographic RNG. Only its hash is stored (app.py:231).

login_rate_limit.note: Limits are 30 attempts per IP and 15 per account every 15 minutes, then HTTP 429. These count every attempt, not only failed ones, but they still throttle repeated failures.

password_policy.evidence: app.py:156 if len(password) < 12: return fail('Use a password with at least 12 characters.', 400)
password_policy.note: The server enforces a minimum of 12 characters on signup.

sql_parameterized.note: Every query that includes user input uses ? placeholders. The only SQL without parameters is the fixed schema script at app.py:32.
